It gets its own subtask and its own full test run for exactly that reason -- the proof of a pure refactor is that all three existing UniqueLprCaseClaims suites pass with no test edits. subtasks.title: Add LprRepossessionsQuery: single-pass A1 funnel with the DB-repos leg
subtasks.approach: New app/Clickhouse/Queries/LprRepossessionsQuery.php, modelled on UniqueLprCaseClaimsQuery (same static window()/monthlySeries() API, same zodDb() prefix, same NO-ClickhouseQuery-subclass decision so a failure propagates instead of rendering as an indistinguishable 0 -- 4 of 29 entitled orgs legitimately read 0 per q10-q11-oscar.md). SQL body = the production-validated docs/investigations/DEV-2464/measure-org-monthly.sql, with the four q14/rescope corrections applied: (1) the insightlpr exclusion via the orgs FINAL CTE on BOTH sides (position(lower(replaceRegexpAll(coalesce(name,''),'[^a-zA-Z0-9]','')),'insightlpr') = 0), never a titlemax needle; (2) uniqExact over the (forwarder_org_id, agent_org_id, vin) triple, never uniq (HyperLogLog, and this figure is reconciled against Brek's report); (3) restructured to a SINGLE reference to the deduped CTE, i.e. one pass over zod.public_billing_events -- the measured SQL references it three times (pairs, floor_date, final FROM) and okf/concepts/billing-events.md measures each extra reference as exactly 3.0x the read_rows; (4) explicit 'UTC' in every date function (q9: neither CH connection block carries a timezone key). Per-table CDC discipline, deliberately asymmetric per driver-verification.md: FINAL + _peerdb_is_deleted = 0 on public_hotlist (13.3% raw overcount whole-table) and public_api_keys/public_orgs; _peerdb_is_deleted = 0 WITHOUT FINAL on public_hotlist_status_log (raw == FINAL exactly, FINAL costs 10x) and on public_billing_events -- whose engine is ReplacingMergeTree(_peerdb_version), ONE argument, so FINAL does NOT drop its tombstones and the predicate is mandatory and not interchangeable (okf billing-events.md, PG-028). Recoveries leg is A1 and only A1: zod.public_hotlist FINAL status=3 join zod.public_hotlist_status_log new_status=3, keeping backyard's date floor and the deliberate h.vin-not-normalised asymmetry. Reuses the sibling's validated claims/kept CTE text rather than re-deriving it (q4's 'reuse, do not re-port'); see plan.md for why that reuse is by copy plus a cross-check test rather than by extracting a shared fragment out of the shipped class.
subtasks.intended_diffs: LprRepossessionsQuery.php: public static window(?int $orgId, CarbonInterface $start, CarbonInterface $end): array{deduped:int, db_repos:int} and monthlySeries(?int $orgId, CarbonInterface $through): array<string, array{deduped:int, db_repos:int}> keyed 'Y-m-01'; private run() doing the same strtr token substitution ({db},{org},{f},{t},{event_type}) plus a new {floor} token; private sql(bool $bucketed). SQL: WITH orgs AS (...FINAL, _peerdb_is_deleted = 0), claims AS (billing_events INNER JOIN api_keys FINAL, WHERE _peerdb_is_deleted = 0 AND event_type = {event_type} AND ts BETWEEN {f} AND {t}, projecting claim_date and toStartOfMonth(...,'UTC') AS bucket), kept AS (insightlpr exclusion on fo/ao + ({org} = 0 OR forwarder = {org} OR agent = {org})), deduped AS (SELECT bucket, forwarder_org_id, agent_org_id, vin, min(claim_date) AS claim_date FROM kept WHERE success AND vin != '' GROUP BY bucket, forwarder_org_id, agent_org_id, vin). Final SELECT reads deduped ONCE: FROM deduped d LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, org_id, vin FROM {db}.public_hotlist FINAL WHERE _peerdb_is_deleted = 0 AND status = 3) h ON h.org_id = d.agent_org_id AND h.vin = d.vin AND d.agent_org_id != 0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT hotlist_id, created_at FROM {db}.public_hotlist_status_log WHERE _peerdb_is_deleted = 0 AND new_status = 3 AND toDate(created_at,'UTC') >= {floor}) hsl ON hsl.hotlist_id = h.id, selecting uniqExact(triple) AS deduped and uniqExactIf(triple, toDate(hsl.created_at,'UTC') >= d.claim_date - 7) AS db_repos, with GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket when bucketed. TWO equivalences this restructure rests on and must state in the docblock: max(created_at) >= X is true iff ANY transition row satisfies it, so uniqExactIf over the join fan-out equals backyard's grouped max(); and {floor} = (UTC window start date - 7 days) computed in PHP is <= min(claim_date) - 7, i.e. strictly looser, so it cannot change the answer -- it only replaces the floor_date CTE that was a second pass over billing_events. Keep the agent_org_id != 0 guard that the dropped `pairs` CTE used to carry (q7: an unresolved agent must count in deduped but never in db_repos). New test file mirrors tests/Feature/Clickhouse/UniqueLprCaseClaimsQueryTest.php structurally (RequiresClickhouse, #[Group('clickhouse')], local seedOrg/seedApiKey/seedClaim helpers plus new seedHotlist/seedStatusLog helpers) and pins the RULES, never the production number: full-triple dedup; insightlpr excluded on each side; titlemax NOT excluded; event_type (not type) as discriminator and ls-claim out; inclusive UTC BETWEEN on the integer ts at both boundary seconds; org axis OR-match on both sides plus a third org excluded; repo transition exactly at claim_date-7 counts and one day earlier does not; a NULL/absent claimed_by_org_id counts in deduped but never in db_repos; a status=3 hotlist with no new_status=3 transition never counts; a soft-deleted (_peerdb_is_deleted = 1) and a duplicate-version hotlist row do not inflate db_repos; a tombstoned billing_events row is excluded even though FINAL would keep it (the 1-arg-engine regression); monthly bucketing on UTC calendar months; a dead-port ClickHouse connection raises ClickhouseException instead of returning 0. Plus ONE cross-check test that the deduped stage agrees with UniqueLprCaseClaimsQuery::window()['deduped'] on the same seeded fixture -- read-only on the sibling class, and the drift alarm for the copied CTE.

Add canViewCardData() on the existing FeatureEnum::COMPANY_METRICS (q1: do NOT add a FeatureEnum case -- it already covers both CLARITY_PRO and CLARITY_PRO_PLUS and a second case would break tests/Unit/Enums/FeatureEnumTest.php's assertCount(18)), copying the sibling's guard ORDERING (auth()->check() first, then canView(), then the entitlement OR admin_impersonator). Add the getCacheTTL() floor (q13 part 2: the base collapses to 10s under admin_impersonator, SHORTER than this query's contended p99, so every impersonated re-render would start a fresh scan -- a stampede, not staleness). Mirror all three UTC label-axis overrides (dc3, okf checklist item 6): getGraphLabels(), getHighlightedMonthsFromFilter(), getDescription(). Expose fetchMonthlySeries()/fetchWindowTotal()/runWindowQuery() as seams so counting doubles can pin the round-trip AC (the ClickHouse driver never fires DB::listen, so a listener-based assertion would silently prove nothing). subtasks.title: Validate the restructured SQL against production and calibrate the herd-guard constants
subtasks.approach: The single live, read-only measurement node -- it exists because two things CANNOT be pinned in CI. (a) Correctness at scale: t2's single-pass restructure is a genuine rewrite of the shape that was validated in perf-measurement.md, so it must re-reproduce Jul 2026 deduped 11,975 / db_repos ~9,135 platform-wide and 7,230 / ~5,369 for org 165 (the +18 over Brek's 9,116-9,117 is live-hotlist drift at ~1.3-1.6/day in one direction, reconciled across three readings -- not a dedup artefact). (b) The herd-guard constants: q13-caching.md forbids inheriting DEV-2463's 12/90/60 because they were tuned against a ~40M-row query with a 9.3s contended p99 while A1 measures 664,270,998 read_rows / 15.04 GB / 2.50 GB peak -- roughly 16x -- and under-sizing COLD_BLOCK_SECONDS is the documented failure mode where every waiter times out and computes anyway, turning N tabs into N x 2.5 GB. Measure this card's own contended p99 INTERLEAVED (perf-measurement.md section 2 records a sequential batch producing a badly misleading result; MEMORY.md carries the same lesson from DEV-2464 itself) and re-derive COLD_BLOCK_SECONDS > that p99, COLD_LOCK_SECONDS > CLICKHOUSE_TIMEOUT_QUERY (60), MIN_TTL_SECONDS, REFRESH_LOCK_SECONDS > 0. Read the server-side envelope from the X-ClickHouse-Summary RESPONSE HEADER (q12 is closed: no READ ON REMOTE grant needed) and treat wall clock as the least informative number available -- it misled this ticket three times. Confirm the single-pass claim by comparing read_rows against the 664M three-reference baseline (expect roughly one billing_events pass, ~40M, instead of three). Read-only as readonly_user; aggregates and envelopes only, never raw rows; do not commit any credential-shaped harness (checkpoint.sh's PII scan correctly refuses it -- read creds from chlocal/.env at runtime).
subtasks.intended_diffs: New docs/investigations/DEV-2464/single-pass-validation.md recording, per variant: the reproduced funnel stages against the ticket targets, read_rows / read_bytes / memory_usage from the summary header, and an interleaved n>=8 timing distribution (min/median/p90/max) for the worst-case org. Then: final constant values in LprRepossessions.php with a docblock citing the measured p99 rather than DEV-2463's figures; the guard-window test's p99 threshold updated to match; any SQL correction the reproduction forces in LprRepossessionsQuery.php. Build Record inputs to hand back to the driver: the measured envelope (which replaces the ticket's 'restate the unmeasured production-Postgres cost' AC with a measured ClickHouse one), variant B recorded as measured-and-REJECTED with its 23%-of-counted-pairs repo_date divergence so nobody re-proposes the 5.9x-cheaper clarity.hotlist shortcut as a free win, and the TitleMax structural understatement (53.0% against a 75-88% peer pack) noted as known and deliberate.
subtasks.disposition: OUT of Phase 4. Operator-run PRE-MERGE verification gate: re-validate the restructured single-pass SQL against production read-only and calibrate the herd-guard constants from this card's own measured p99. t3 ships PROVISIONAL constants and a provisional threshold in its test; t5 finalises both.

subtasks.title: Add the lpr-repossessions Playwright spec
subtasks.approach: Mirror tests/e2e/unique-lpr-case-claims.spec.ts for the new card: it is the sibling precedent for exactly this card family and the only place the two UI-visible ACs (a number renders for a Pro org; the locked em-dash placeholder renders for a non-Pro org, in the same grid slot, with no sparkline and no 'Upgrade to Pro' upsell) are checked against a real browser. Carries the sibling's login trap verbatim: GET /__qa/login/{id} sets admin_impersonator unconditionally and BYPASSES the Pro gate, so non-Pro locked-card scenarios MUST authenticate by OTP via loginAsNonProOrgAdmin and must FAIL rather than skip if only the QA login is available. The UTC month axis is not independently observable from the UI on a fixed clock, so it stays pinned in PHPUnit (t3) and is not re-asserted here. Lowest-value node in the DAG and the natural trim point -- e2e is not run by CI (tests/e2e is Playwright against a live environment), so it verifies nothing on the PR by itself.
